name: RSVpreF
note: RSVpreF is the antigen name of Abrysvo, Pfizer's bivalent RSV prefusion F vaccine (120 mcg, 60 mcg preF A and 60 mcg preF B, Abrysvo label DailyMed setid be18292e-b1a2-4815-a0ed-003efaa6bea3, published 2026-07-20). Every study on the row gives 'RSVpreF' against placebo: NCT05035212 is RENOIR, the Abrysvo efficacy trial in adults 60 and over (org study id C3671013); NCT06866405, NCT07653100 and NCT07819097 carry Pfizer's C3671 protocol series, the Abrysvo programme. All four sit in populations the label already covers or outside the US, so none is a layer: see drafts/pfe_abrysvo.csv

name: RSVpreF Vaccine
note: the same vaccine under its long name. NCT07768345 (C3671085, the Abrysvo protocol series) gives 'RSVpreF Vaccine' to immunocompromised adults 18 and over to study revaccination at 1, 2 and 3 years; Abrysvo is labelled for adults 18 to 59 at increased risk and for everyone 60 and over, so these patients are already inside the label and the revenue

name: PDS Implant Pre-Filled with 100 mg/mL Ranibizumab
note: the Port Delivery System with ranibizumab 100 mg/mL is Susvimo (ranibizumab injection), BLA761197, label set 9c6d9e2a-9a77-4d11-b692-de87cfde3444 (openFDA, effective 2025-11-21). NCT04108156 is Pagoda, the PDS study in diabetic macular edema, and openFDA drugsfda lists an efficacy supplement to BLA761197 approved 2025-02-03; the label now reads 'Diabetic Macular Edema (DME) who have previously responded to at least two intravitreal injections of a VEGF inhibitor'. Already approved, so the readout is not a layer, and Susvimo carries no model in the book to put one on (no assumptions rows; CMS Part B 2024 shows 195 beneficiaries)

name: IIV-HD (standalone)
target: Fluzone, Fluzone Hd Quadrivalent, Fluzone High Dose, Fluzone Intradermal, Fluzone Quadrivalent
note: IIV-HD is high-dose inactivated influenza vaccine, Sanofi's Fluzone High-Dose (Efluelda in Europe), labelled in the US 'for use in persons 65 years of age and older' (DailyMed setid de0e2089-f781-4d47-99f5-c2a1b7b0f1eb, 2026-07-06). In NCT07890454 it is a comparator arm: the study tests 'IIV-HD + NVXC19', a combination of high-dose influenza vaccine and Nuvaxovid (Matrix-M adjuvanted COVID-19 vaccine), against each given alone, on antibody titres. The readout belongs to that combination, which the book holds no asset for, so it is not a layer on Fluzone, and Fluzone carries no model in any case. No trial row is written: pinning NCT07890454 to Fluzone or to Nuvaxovid would be wrong, since neither is the product under test
